text.p: Intel, Microsoft and Compaq Computer will propose a digital-TV strategy Monday at a broadcasters conference in Las Vegas, the Wall Street Journal said Friday.
The companies will try to convince television broadcasters to adopt their digital telvision standards, to ensure personal computers have a large role in home entertainment, the newspaper reported.
At the National Association of Broadcasters conference, the companies would propose a strategy emphasising Internet-based information services and interactivity, the Journal said.
